stories.title: Russell Brand sentenced to 10.5 years in prison for rape and sexual assault
new_facts: Trial ended: Brand sentenced to 10.5 years in prison for rape and sexual assault after four-week trial.
Father Ron Brand says jury corrupt, sentence unfair, victims 'chased and harassed' Brand.
Defence in mitigation called rape a 'short, momentary failure'; one victim 'not particularly vulnerable'; shower demand 'not surprising'.
Brand, 51, held at HMP Wandsworth, reportedly to be moved to a sex offenders' prison.
Judge called Brand a sexual predator who believed fame meant he could act 'unhindered by the rules'; offences about two decades ago.
Elon Musk reposted a claim that the UK pursued Brand but not migrant rape gangs.
Rape conviction relates to an offence in 2009.
Victims told court they live with daily trauma; NBC's Danny Cevallos explains how sentence was determined.
stories.line: Comedian Russell Brand was sentenced to over ten years in prison for rape and sexual assault of multiple women.

stories.title: Nvidia launches probe into CEO Jensen Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy
new_facts: Alice Huang was a Megaspeed executive (no relation to Huang); Huang is cooperating with the board investigation.
Huang hired crisis PR firm Heller as early as October 2025, when first linked to a suspected Chinese spy.
stories.line: Nvidia's CEO admitted an affair with a woman US officials allege was a Chinese spy; the company launched an independent probe.

stories.title: FDA orders GLP-1 drugs to carry warning on rare condition that can cause permanent blindness
new_facts: FDA ordered GLP-1 drugmakers to add a warning label about a rare eye condition that can cause sudden blindness.
Names the condition as NAION and says the warning applies to all GLP-1 drugs via updated prescribing information.
Novonesis is exploring gut health supplements for patients on GLP-1 drugs, a potential new market.
stories.line: FDA is requiring GLP-1 drugmakers to warn that the drugs may raise the risk of a rare, untreatable condition causing sudden permanent blindness.

stories.title: Nvidia intervention moved Commerce's Megaspeed chip smuggling probe to DOJ
new_facts: Nvidia lost $330bn in value to a seven-month low after Huang admitted an affair; board investigating; China denies; Musk backs Huang.
Alleged spy named Alice Huang; Huang memo apologizes on record; Trump backs him while other Republicans may be tougher.
Shares fell over 8% at open; board committee of independent directors with outside counsel will investigate.
Commerce inquiry into Singapore firm Megaspeed was moved to Justice after a top Nvidia executive contacted Commerce officials.
Trump on record: he has not spoken to Huang about it; Musk and finance moguls defend Huang.
China calls the spying allegations a 'smear campaign'; media report says Huang's close contact, a Chinese businesswoman, allegedly passed information to Beijing.
stories.line: A Commerce Department probe into Megaspeed over alleged Nvidia chip smuggling to China was moved to the DOJ after Nvidia intervened.

stories.title: Country singer Ketch Secor calls on artists to break silence on guns after Nashville shooting
new_facts: A country musician publicly urges fellow artists to oppose assault rifles, per CNN podcast.
stories.line: Country musician Ketch Secor is urging other artists to speak out on gun violence despite fear of fan backlash after the Nashville school shooting.

stories.title: France blames Iran's Revolutionary Guards for supermarket fridge cyberattacks
new_facts: French officials formally attribute the October fridge cyberattacks to Iran's Revolutionary Guards, ending the unidentified-attacker status.
Foreign minister Barrot confirms IRGC responsibility on record, calls hacks 'unprecedented', and vows European sanctions against Tehran.
Hack hit more than 1,000 stores; a cyber unit linked to the Revolutionary Guard is blamed.
stories.line: France says Iran's Revolutionary Guards hacked commercial fridges and freezers across France last October, knocking them out.

stories.title: Trump claims election fraud without evidence after midterm losses
new_facts: Trump posted on Truth Social questioning honesty of midterms, citing early-voting 'dumps', nearly a week after Democrats' historic wins.
Millions of dollars flowed into prediction markets on election night, trading Democratic control of Congress and Texas governor's race.
Trump said he accepted the midterm shellacking and would consider dealmaking with Democrats before alleging fraud.
Trump's post revived voting-machine conspiracy claims about the midterm results.
stories.line: Trump is claiming election fraud without evidence after midterm losses, reviving voting-machine conspiracy claims.

stories.title: Stephen Miller named White House chief of staff; immigration crackdown to continue
new_facts: Stephen Miller becomes White House chief of staff after the midterm rout; Trump reportedly weighed the historic rejection first.
Harry Enten says Miller's promotion is tone deaf; Susie Wiles left after the GOP midterm trouncing.
Trump tells 60 Minutes that Vance blaming the Iran war for the midterm loss will be historically a good decision.
Miller formally took up the chief of staff role on Monday, replacing Susie Wiles.
Sources say the immigration crackdown will not ease under Miller; lawmakers may be reluctant to work with him.
Miller has shut the door on big business; under Wiles, CEOs had a channel to soften policies.
Congress returns with Republicans having only weeks left of control; Miller's appointment signals readiness to confront opposition.
stories.line: Stephen Miller takes over as White House chief of staff, with sources saying the immigration crackdown won't ease.

stories.title: Trump questions Democrats' midterm wins as Jeffries vows accountability
new_facts: Paul Ryan predicts a frustrated Trump will struggle with a Democratic Congress and may work with Democrats on some issues.
Trump questions early vote numbers and ballot machines after initially accepting the Democratic win; admits deportation policy was 'too tough'.
Jeffries, poised to be Speaker, vows to focus on affordability and 'holding the crooks accountable' on corruption.
stories.line: Trump is questioning Democrats' midterm election wins while Democrats vow to hold officials accountable in the incoming Congress.

stories.title: Senate Republicans split over leadership after midterm losses, delaying vote
new_facts: Senator-elect Annie Andrews (D-SC) named; her old anti-GOP and transgender-rights posts resurfaced after Election Night.
Sen. John Barrasso announces bid for another term as Senate GOP whip, saying Republicans 'remain united in our purpose'.
Ron Johnson and four allies push to delay Tuesday's Senate GOP leadership elections after the midterm losses.
Johnson sent a Monday letter to Conference Chair Tom Cotton seeking delay; Thune faces mutiny as Majority Leader.
At least 30 House Republicans lost their races in the 2026 midterms.
stories.line: Senate Republicans are fighting over leadership after midterm losses, with a delayed vote and a bid to replace the party's top senator.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO's ties to alleged Chinese spy prompt FBI probe, $250bn share drop
stories.line: Nvidia's CEO is under scrutiny over an alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy; the firm lost about $250bn in market value.

stories.title: Massie files articles to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth; Trump backs him
stories.line: A Republican congressman has filed impeachment articles against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, and Trump and Rubio are defending him.

stories.title: Nvidia's Huang draws scrutiny over reported Chinese intelligence targeting
stories.line: Reports say Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by Chinese intelligence, drawing scrutiny over his ties to Trump and a relative's business.

stories.title: Supreme Court clears border wall construction through Texas's Big Bend
stories.line: The Supreme Court let construction of a border wall through Texas's Big Bend area proceed, a ruling that clears a major Trump border project.

stories.title: FBI arrests passenger in suspected homicide on MSC cruise ship off Texas
stories.line: An FBI homicide investigation tied to a cruise ship docked in Galveston; a passenger was arrested and jailed, and no victim or motive has been released.

stories.title: Erika Kirk and Charlamagne criticize Dave Chappelle's jokes about Charlie Kirk's killing
stories.line: Dave Chappelle's jokes about the Charlie Kirk assassination drew condemnation from Erika Kirk and Charlamagne tha God.

stories.title: Russia, Ukraine and US resume peace talks in Abu Dhabi
stories.line: Russia, Ukraine and the US resume trilateral peace talks in Abu Dhabi, with US officials reporting some flexibility from the warring sides.

stories.title: Ohio State fraternity suspended after viral video shows two men on fire
stories.line: An Ohio State fraternity has been suspended after a viral video showed two men on fire during a hazing or stunt incident.

stories.title: Russia pushes strikes toward splitting Ukraine as both sides hit fuel infrastructure
stories.line: Russia is escalating strikes on Ukraine, Zelenskyy warns, while Ukraine hits Russian refineries and Moscow rations fuel.

stories.title: Cruise ship entertainer rescued by fishermen after nine hours overboard off California
stories.line: A cruise ship entertainer fell overboard off Southern California and was rescued by fishermen at least nine hours later.

stories.title: M. John Harrison wins Booker Prize for post-apocalyptic novel
stories.line: British sci-fi author M. John Harrison, 81, won the Booker Prize for his post-apocalyptic novel The End of Everything.

stories.title: Trump says Iran war is 'effectively over' as Tehran demands surrender
stories.line: Trump says the US war with Iran is "effectively over" and renewed strikes are unlikely, though Iran demands surrender and talks remain unconfirmed.

stories.title: LAUSD weighs response to Google AI mandate as families seek answers
stories.line: LAUSD must decide how to respond to a Google AI requirement, and families are asking what it means for their kids.
